workload.summary: Assess every measured internal FIDO operation occurrence; full RP interval is diagnostic
limitations: Registration and authentication call production use cases directly; their CTAP handlers and HID/Bluetooth transport are not traversed.
GetInfo probe exercises the production dispatcher and capability provider; response encoding has HID transport callbacks replaced; ResetAuthenticator uses isolated synthetic storage.
Storage and credential key derivation are synthetic adapters; no real user or credential data is used.
System.nanoTime suspend behavior is not used to claim physical-device timing; this host run does not establish device latency.
real_components: CtapHidCommandDispatcher GetInfo, AuthenticatorInfoProvider and CTAP response encoding
simulated_components: registration/authentication CTAP handlers and HID/Bluetooth transport
